players.product: system-level test (SLT) platforms for AI accelerators and power test equipment

quarterly_data.signal: Q2 2026 results (results deck presented by the CFO and CEO): net sales NT$13,529 million, +14% QoQ and +110% YoY (testing-equipment business NT$13,111 million, 97%); gross profit NT$8,185 million, gross margin 61% (63% in Q1); operating income NT$5,242 million (39% margin, +139% YoY); net income attributable to the parent NT$5,123 million (+162% YoY); EPS NT$12.15. H1 2026: net sales NT$25,389 million (+91% YoY), operating income NT$10,039 million (+130%), EPS NT$21.27, EBITDA NT$12,114 million (+122%). Q2 parent-company sales by product line: Test Instruments & Automatic Testing System (ATS) NT$6,169 million (56%, +14% QoQ, +129% YoY); Semiconductor / Photonics Test Solutions NT$4,386 million (39%, +29% QoQ, +99% YoY). The company says H1 brought consecutive quarters of record-high consolidated sales. Inventory NT$11,358 million at June 2026 vs NT$7,919 million at December 2025.
quarterly_data.figure: Q2 net sales NT$13,529 million (+110% YoY); gross margin 61%; operating margin 39%; EPS NT$12.15; H1 net sales NT$25,389 million (+91% YoY)

quarterly_data.signal: 2026 guidance (results deck): the company says the strong momentum remained for the second half; H2 2026 will be fueled mainly by semiconductor contributions and outperform the first half, with drivers of SLT (system-level test) from AI / HPC / ASIC and photonics test from optical communication / CPO. Test Instruments & ATS sales for power testing continue to come from AI server power (including HVDC) and ESS markets. In H1, Test Instruments & ATS grew 136% YoY and Semiconductor 62% YoY.
quarterly_data.figure: H2 2026 expected to outperform H1 (no specific figure); H1 Test Instruments & ATS +136% YoY, Semiconductor +62% YoY

quarterly_data.signal: Test portfolio presented in the results deck: AI and advanced-packaging test - 3200-HD high-density testing platform (at-speed full-power test, 3kW cooling, up to 36 sites), 3160-H advanced-package FT test handler (>3kW cooling), Sea Cobra Xtreme temperature-forcing system (up to 10kW heat dissipation) and 3832 high-power burn-in test system (5.5KW thermal forcing); CPO test solutions across EPIC wafer/die, light engine and CPO switch - 58604-HS LD burn-in system (up to 2,688 ch/sys), 58721 light-engine O/E test and 58711 CPO switch module test; AI server power test - 63245A regenerative grid simulator (45kW, up to 60 units / 2.7MW in parallel), 62000D-HL DC electronic load (system up to 1.8MW), 8000 ATS (up to 500kW) and battery-backup-unit test systems (17060 scalable up to 4MW); Model 799X 2D/3D wafer metrology for panel-level advanced packaging.
